prep.text: ICA shop (list below). Pantry and frozen items came with the Coop delivery on 3 Nov.
Lunch: orzo makes 3, eat it all.
Dinner: meatballs make 7. Box 2.5 for Sun lunch and 1 for Mon lunch; freeze 1.
Dinner: shawarma makes 6. Box 2.5 for Mon dinner and 1 for Tue lunch. Cook a double batch of bulgur.
No cooking. Evening: move 4 salmon fillets from freezer to fridge to thaw.
Dinner: traybake makes 4. Box 1 for Wed lunch.
Dinner: dal makes 4. Box 1 for Thu lunch.
Dinner: chicken makes 4. Box 1 for Fri lunch.
Assisted-quick dinner. Freezer buffer: 1 curry (from 1 Nov) + 1 meatballs — swap into any solo lunch.

recipes.name: Prawn, leek & tomato orzo
ingredients: 400 g frozen peeled prawns (skalade räkor), thawed under cold water
1 leek, sliced; 1 tbsp olive oil
250 g wholewheat orzo
400 g crushed tomatoes, 5 dl water or unsalted stock
½ tsp chilli flakes (adults: extra at the table)
1 lemon, flat-leaf parsley
steps: Soften leek in oil, 5 min.
Add orzo, tomatoes and water. Simmer 10–12 min, stirring, until the orzo is tender.
Stir in prawns; heat 2–3 min until hot through.
Finish with lemon zest, juice and chopped parsley.

recipes.name: Swedish meatballs with mash & braised red cabbage
ingredients: 750 g beef mince (nötfärs)
1 dl rolled oats, 1 dl milk, 1 egg, 1 onion finely grated, ½ tsp ground allspice (kryddpeppar)
1.5 kg potatoes, scrubbed; 1–2 dl milk, 1 tbsp unsalted butter
½ red cabbage, shredded; 1 apple, grated; 1 tbsp rapeseed oil; 1 tbsp water
2 dl crème fraîche, 2 dl unsalted stock, 1 tsp low-salt soy
Black pepper
steps: Soak oats in milk 5 min; mix with mince, egg, onion and allspice. Roll ~40 balls.
Air fry in both air fryers at 200°C for 10–12 min, shaking halfway.
Boil potatoes with skin 20 min; mash with milk and butter.
Braise cabbage and apple in oil and water, lid on, 15 min.
Simmer crème fraîche, stock and soy 3 min for the sauce; pepper to taste.
recipes.note: Freezes well — freeze 1 portion as buffer.

recipes.name: Chicken shawarma bowls with bulgur & crispy chickpeas
ingredients: 900 g chicken thigh fillets (kycklinglårfilé)
2 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp turmeric, ½ tsp cinnamon; 1 lemon; 2 tbsp olive oil
1 can chickpeas, rinsed and dried
6 dl bulgur (for Sun + Mon)
2 cucumbers, 3 tomatoes, 1 red onion, flat-leaf parsley
3 dl Turkish yoghurt, 2 tbsp tahini
steps: Toss chicken with spices, lemon zest, half the juice and 1 tbsp oil.
Air fry chicken at 200°C for 14–16 min, shaking halfway; slice.
Air fry chickpeas with 1 tbsp oil and a pinch of cumin at 200°C for 12 min in the second air fryer.
Cook bulgur. Chop cucumber, tomato, onion and parsley.
Whisk yoghurt with tahini and the rest of the lemon juice; build bowls.

recipes.name: Salmon & root veg traybake with dill yoghurt
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets (laxfilé), thawed
500 g beetroot, 3 carrots, 2 parsnips, in wedges
1 red onion, in wedges; 2 tbsp rapeseed oil; 1 tsp dried thyme
2 dl Turkish yoghurt, fresh dill, 1 lemon
steps: Toss root veg and onion with oil and thyme. Roast at 220°C for 25 min.
Push veg aside, add salmon, top with lemon zest. Roast 12 min more.
Mix yoghurt with chopped dill and lemon juice.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Red lentil & spinach dal with flatbread
ingredients: 3 dl red lentils, rinsed
1 onion, chopped; 4 cm ginger, grated; pinch of asafoetida (hing)
1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp garam masala
400 g crushed tomatoes, 400 ml coconut milk, 5 dl water
225 g frozen chopped spinach; 1 lemon
Wholewheat tortillas, warmed; Turkish yoghurt
steps: Soften onion in oil, 5 min. Add ginger, hing and spices; 1 min.
Add lentils, tomatoes, coconut milk and water. Simmer 20 min, stirring.
Stir in spinach; 3 min. Squeeze in lemon.
Warm tortillas 2 min in the air fryer; serve with yoghurt.

recipes.name: Miso-ginger chicken with soba & pak choi
ingredients: 700 g chicken thigh fillets, in strips
1 tbsp white miso, 4 cm ginger grated, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tsp rice vinegar
250 g soba noodles
2 pak choi, halved; 2 carrots, in ribbons
2 spring onions, 1 tbsp sesame seeds; low-salt soy at the table
steps: Mix miso, ginger, sesame oil and vinegar; toss with chicken.
Air fry chicken at 200°C for 12 min, shaking halfway.
Cook soba; add pak choi and carrot for the last 2 min. Drain and rinse.
Top noodles with chicken, spring onion and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Salmon burgers, wedges & cucumber salad
ingredients: 1 pack frozen salmon burgers (laxburgare), lower-salt
600 g potatoes, in wedges; 1 tbsp oil; 1 tsp paprika
1 cucumber, fresh dill, 1 dl Turkish yoghurt, ½ lemon
steps: Toss wedges with oil and paprika. Air fry at 200°C for 20 min, shaking twice.
Salmon burgers in the second air fryer at 190°C for 10–12 min.
Slice cucumber thinly; mix with dill, yoghurt and lemon juice.
